steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Dur-nar, I brought my report—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Dur-nar?
There is no sign of any person, only a scene of utter chaos. Crownslayer forces her way through the multitude of cardboard boxes.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What a mess... I can hardly see the floor.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Dur-nar—
Is there somebody there?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Instructor Dur-nar's not here. You can give the report to me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Where's Dur-nar?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not sure. I just got back a few days ago. Lada—I mean, Gummy and I are the only ones here.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We only just got approval to set up the new office, so the others are probably busy with red-tape and whatever. I'm heading out, too, in a bit; there's a Student Assembly letter that I need to send—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Here's my report. Please give it to her.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Just a sec.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're always on your own. I guess you're not really into talking to us, but we're all from Ursus, and now we're all Rhodes Island operators.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Everything's starting from scratch with this new office. I was thinking maybe we could get more done by helping each other out.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...What do you want?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's not what I mean! What I'm trying to say is, if you need something, feel free to ask for help from the office, from any of us. You don't have to do everything yourself.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Of course, we'll ask if we need your help.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Instructor Dur-nar says the only contact you get with anybody is submitting your reports. Not that there's anything wrong with doing your own thing, but I thought I might check in with you, since you're here.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You wouldn't want me to show up here more.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't try to decide what I think. I know you had something to do with Chernobog and Reunion, but I don't know what you did, and I'm not about to find out.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's a wound that keeps getting reopened, but trying to avoid it won't help it heal either.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The important thing is that you're on our side, and we can use as many people on our side as we can get.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So, yeah, if you ever find yourself in need of help, just give us a call.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I will, if I need it.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Lyudmila!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...I was just going to put in your bail.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Well, you can thank that kind soul for saving us the bail money!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: How did you get out? And what was that explosion just now...?

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: —Run—

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: After them—!

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Nothing to see here, just another ordinary afternoon in Grypherburg.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Never mind that for now, I better get out of here in case the cops show up, or I'll be back in that hole.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't go back yet. Come with me. I have questions.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: How did you know the cops got me? I thought I was gonna rot in there for sure.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Someone saw the cops questioning you. You remember the kid who lives across the street?

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Kid? The redhead? I remember I didn't like that brooding look of his—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't judge people by appearances. Have you sold all your goods?

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: There was one who didn't meet with me. I was waiting for him when I got arrested. Bloke from Odoyev... what's his name again?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Rus, occupation: barber. Lives on Fifth Avenue. Two infants at home, wife died of flu complications.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Yes... that's the one. I got everyone else.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: How did they pay for the energy converters?

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Huh? I thought they didn't have to pay? They get the energy converters for free as long as they keep buying the goods from us.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: You were testing me! You trust me that little?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: People who are trustworthy don't usually end up in jail.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Come on, let's not talk about that!

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Were you concerned that me or someone else might be selling the energy converters behind your back?

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Not gonna happen. Everyone's in your debt. We'd all be frozen solid without you. We have nothing but gratitude towards you—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No, I understand some of you would like to make more money, but you should not do it by exploiting people who are in even more need than you are. That's not what I wanted to see when I chose to sell through you guys.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I have other channels, but I chose to work with you instead of working on my own. You should understand that all it does is add extra risk.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Honestly, I don't understand why you're doing this... you're just doing good by people with nothing in it for you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I've dealt with Rus's case, but we need to put the recruitment of new clients on hold for now. I'll let you know when there are any updates.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Oh? Will our supplies be cut?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Our reserves can meet the needs of existing users for about two weeks. I'll try to get supply restored during this time.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If any new clients show up, use discretion and due diligence, and help out where you can with the money that I gave you, but don't tell them about the supply chain issues. We don't want to cause panic.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Of course, I trust you... anything I can help with?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No, this is my responsibility. I might be away for a few days. Find some excuse if anyone asks.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Jailed Worker
steps.text: Sure, but how do I reach you if something happens?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Come here and leave a note, just like I taught you.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Worker
steps.text: Lyudmila! Haven't seen you down here for a while. Are you going outside the city?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Yes, I have something to do. Is there an unguarded exit ahead?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Worker
steps.text: No, but they won't give you any trouble if they see you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Any suspicious intruders from the mobility layer recently?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Worker
steps.text: No. Police patrols have dropped too. If you're asking which exit has no cops watching, it's the same answer as usual. They only come at fixed hours; we keep a watch the rest of the time.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Good, thank you.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Worker
steps.text: Come back soon!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I think this is the place...
Crownslayer kneels and wipes away the dust, revealing an etched mark on the floor.
She looks up and sees identical emergency ladders neatly installed between the layers. She climbs one of them and goes deeper into the mobility layer.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Can you hear me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hello?
Is it safe on your side?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: This is a new safehouse. It's been checked for mics and cameras.
Good. I don't have much time...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Are you alright?
Not great, but that's not important. They may have found out about us transferring energy to Grypherburg. I haven't faced any consequences yet...
They've updated their base stations. It's likely that they'll be building new energy pipelines next, then abandon the old one. We need to make a couple of preparations before that.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You planning to tap the new pipeline?
We must.
The original pipeline was already basically a dedicated Tsarevgrad one. Now they're probably going to pave it straight to the palace. They don't even care about the other nobles anymore.
They say it's to 'conserve resources', but how is it not a waste to keep building pipelines that could be destroyed by Catastrophe any moment?
I heard workers are already being reassigned over here. Anything of the sort from Grypherburg?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No... Grypherburg is dealing with its own problems.
You mean the students—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Although news about the ore exhaustion got out, what you're researching has bought the council time. The Fourth Army also had to dealt with internal unrest of its own...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Nobles, soldiers, workers, no one is making any rash moves right now, except for these students who are completely ignorant of the currents under the surface.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Oh, I'm not accusing you. But if you could tell me more about what you're researching—
Let's talk about the topic at hand first. The old pipeline should remain in service until the new one is complete, but we'll need to find a different way to communicate.
If I recall correctly, your comms are using a foreign company's independent network?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Yes, a rental base station operated by a foreign-owned company in Ursus.
That's the problem. Even foreign-owned companies are potentially subject to intense surveillance, especially after the Far North Broadcast.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Not even if we use a new anonymous channel each time?

The base stations on my end have been updated. Hard to tell if someone might have added new 'features'. Can you find radio equipment with an independent network, one that doesn't use a commercial base station?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You're talking about high-level military equipment? That might take some time.
Try. If you succeed, you can continue to reach me on this channel.
If you don't... you may have to wait for me to find an opportunity to contact you from my end. If you don't hear from me in two weeks, destroy all evidence of ever having communicated with me.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...We'll all do our best.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Take care.
You too.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I really can't go out to help?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Leto just went out after leaving a letter. Istina and the others don't come back to the office much either. Don't they need my help?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima was taken away because she tried to help me, but I couldn't do anything—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I know you're worried, Gummy, but someone needs to stay here to deal with the office's work until the next group of operators arrive in Grypherburg.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Building a new Oripathy treatment center, assisting the government with the registration and monitoring of Oripathy patients... there's a lot to do.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Besides, we're making sure that they can focus on whatever it is they have to do.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I know it's important, but I'm the only one who's not helping rescue Zima...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I don't want to be like that. They wouldn't have gotten Zima if I wasn't being dumb that night!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I know how you feel, Little Cub, but I promised Istina to protect—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Is Zima in?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The cops took Zima—oh, Crownslayer!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...You can call me Lyudmila. What do you mean, the cops took Zima?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Govno, I should have come sooner. Do you know where she is? How can I help?

spans.text: , I should have come sooner. Do you know where she is? How can I help?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Zima is in the quarantine zone. We're making plans to rescue her.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The quarantine zone? Katorga Raion? That's basically Pavlovich's own little fiefdom. What can you—what can Rhodes do?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: The Ursus Student Self-Government Group... the children are trying to rescue their own.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But I'm not helping! Zima's in there because of me, and there's nothing I can do...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You're sure Zima's being held in the quarantine zone?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Rosa has confirmed it through multiple sources, and she's apparently seen Pavlovich herself.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: But she couldn't get Zima out... or rather, Zima doesn't want to leave.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima doesn't want to leave?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Why do you say that—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: A hunch.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do you have any advanced communicators here that run on their own network without using a commercial base station? I've asked all my contacts, but there's no one selling this stuff, even on the black market.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sounds like something that only the military will have, or folks like Closure who like to fiddle with things on their own.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Most branch offices will not have something of that grade without making a special application. Why do you need it?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Saving lives.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Rosa said there's a radio blackout on the quarantine zone. Even those communicators won't work.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (Lowers voice) No, I need to contact the one who's helping me steal electricity.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: My communications there may be compromised. I need a more secure method.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Steal—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Steal electricity?!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Not so loud.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: So you're the one behind the cheap energy in the city these days.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I had a lot of help.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Well, I guess I shouldn't be so surprised. You came to Ursus before us, and you were the one who built our intelligence network in the Central Governorate.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'll be going if there's no such communicator at the office. Take care of yourselves. I'll see what I can do about Zima.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You take care too. Stay hidden.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (Mutters) Communicator... communicator?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I remember now!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The listening device that we used on the day of the ball was a student's handiwork. Zima said she built her very own set of radio equipment—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Where is this student now?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: ...I don't know. Zima got the stuff, I guess she's the only one who knows them.
